chapter: Postwar records, Miami and Los Angeles
title: Club Brazil engagement in California
summary: After Miami the band went to Hollywood's Club Brazil in January 1946 and was a success with a well-rehearsed, young band.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: He did. Okay, in 1945, you had that week eight days in Cuba, you came back, did you, Mario, all of you come back together?
Okay, and then you remained down and finished the show in Miami Beach, right?
Okay, we are now in January 1946. Did you go to California, to the Club Brazil, then? That year?
Yeah, around that time we went to California at the Club Brazil......
..... and really, I was a success. No because it was me, it just the band was cooking and, you know, a

well-rehearsed band and very enthusiastic. We had a lot of young musicians in the band that was very talented; Mangual, Vidal, Paquito. Rene Hernandez was young, tremendous musician, tremendous arranger.
That's right, Rene was in the band.
Let's see, Joe Loco got drafted in '45 then Rene came in, right?
